kineTic is the universal execution and transduction controller of the
SSCCS stack. The controller supervises, orchestrates, and bridges every
kind of executor, from software agents to physical signal transducers,
hardware actuators, human-machine interfaces, and external systems, all
unified under a coordinate-based contract protocol.

## Layer Position

kineTic supervises executor types; actus manages agent instances. The
boundary keeps the controller general:

- kineTic defines what an executor is: the ontology of executor types
  under one coordinate-based contract.
- actus is the hub of the agent type. It manages the lifecycle of any
  agent, vendor-agnostic; telos is the base system agent instance among
  them.
- Signal, hardware, human-machine, and bridge executors are further types
  under the same supervision.

## Executor Types

| Executor type | Supervised role |
|:---|:---|
| agent | software agent hub (actus) with agent instances (telos and third-party agents) |
| signal | coordinate receipt and interpretation over Chton(Tagma-Signal), physical emission through Chton |
| hardware | FPGA, robot controllers, and sensor networks |
| hmi | human input into coordinates, system state back to humans |
| bridge | interoperability with external distributed systems |

## The Contract

The unifying mechanism is a single coordinate-based contract protocol.
Commands are addressed by coordinate, and results are deposited as facts
in neXus. **One contract serves every executor type, so a new executor
type adds a supervisor instead of a protocol.** The actus to telos wire
contract is expressed as an instance of this universal contract.

## Integration

kineTic is the execution consumer of the substrate. It addresses through
synTagma, records through neXus, materializes through Chton, and
transduces through Tagma Signal. The integration surface is where the
controller earns its place: execution is wired to state and medium rather
than standing apart from them.

## Status

Planned. No implementation exists yet. The layer definition, the executor
type ontology, and the contract principle are the current deliverables.
Building starts at the boundary, as in the rest of the stack: the
universal contract first, then the supervisors behind it.

## Direction

- Define the universal coordinate-based contract in the core.
- Build the agent supervisor (actus) as the first executor type, with
  telos as the base system agent instance.
- Follow with signal, hardware, human-machine, and bridge supervisors.
- Integrate execution with neXus state, Tagma Signal, and Chton
  materialization.
